criteria.title: Use only the supported provider cost surface
criteria.model: Use only the supported provider cost surface. GCP production reads use Cloud Billing export through the public BigQuery API, never the private Console `BillingData` GraphQL endpoint.
criteria.bar: Use only the supported provider cost surface. GCP production reads use Cloud Billing export through the public BigQuery API, never the private Console `BillingData` GraphQL endpoint.
criteria.method:
Run npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/gcp-api-client.test.ts. Inspect GoogleBigQueryBillingExportReader.read and billingQuery in gcp-api-client.ts: requests must target bigquery.googleapis.com/bigquery/v2/projects/*/queries with NAMED run/window parameters, maxResults and maximumBytesBilled. Inspect the production spend caller in hosted-lifecycle-store.ts. Healthy requires the supported-export tests green and no Console BillingData caller on this settlement path.

As-built detector supplement: execute the bound files with exact check.cases, including nonzero billing/auth/query/routine/schema positive control, this BAR's named injected counterexamples and incomplete-source controls. Analyzer: packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/deferred-spend-source-census.ts. Immutable inspection: capability:git-evidence {op:'readFileAtCommit',rootHarnessSlug:'papercusp',commitSha:'93aa78e047b084121aa97d31e2de170fa32140ad',path:'packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/deferred-spend-source-census.test.ts',byte_offset:0,byte_limit:4096}; page to EOF, same full commit and full repository-relative paths for analyzer and original bound tests. Calibration is not a current production census. Missing selectors or census evidence stays UNKNOWN; never choose population from detector output or infer production absence from green fixtures.

criteria.title: Preserve exact accounting and conservative safety gates
criteria.model: Preserve exact accounting and conservative safety gates. Preserve exact gross, credits, net micros and currency. Keep existing integer-cents budget gates conservative; never round spend down or equate net-zero-after-credit with zero gross usage.
criteria.bar: Preserve exact accounting and conservative safety gates. Preserve exact gross, credits, net micros and currency. Keep existing integer-cents budget gates conservative; never round spend down or equate net-zero-after-credit with zero gross usage.
criteria.method: Run npm run test:file -- libs/generic/deployment-driver/src/workspace-host-test-harness.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/gcp-api-client.test.ts. Inspect createWorkspaceHostSpendObservation: grossMicros+creditMicros equals netMicros, currency is retained, and budgetCents is ceil(grossMicros/10000) using BigInt. Healthy requires credited-net-zero and nonintegral-cent positive controls plus malformed/noncanonical cases pass.
criteria.driftMarkers: Any accepted observation loses micros/currency, conflates zero net with zero gross, permits inconsistent net, or rounds gross budget exposure downward.

criteria.title: Reconcile the retained ledger atomically and idempotently
criteria.model: Reconcile the retained ledger atomically and idempotently. Reconcile the surviving host row by atomic, idempotent read-modify-write of the whole `cost_signals` array. Preserve every prior signal and the original deferral history.
criteria.bar: Reconcile the retained ledger atomically and idempotently. Reconcile the surviving host row by atomic, idempotent read-modify-write of the whole `cost_signals` array. Preserve every prior signal and the original deferral history.
criteria.method: Run npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/hosted-lifecycle-store.integration.test.ts. The real-PG/RLS concurrent-first-read test must preserve both unrelated array entries and the original spendSettlement, append a provider observation once, and converge only after the second stable due pass. Inspect applySpendSignalPatch for host row lock, whole-array RMW and version recheck; provider reads must stay outside transactions.
criteria.driftMarkers: Concurrent ticks append duplicate evidence, lose an unrelated signal or original deferral, write outside workspace RLS, or settle after a single read. The real-PG integration assertion fails.

criteria.title: Keep unavailable or unstable settlement explicit and retryable
criteria.model: Keep unavailable or unstable settlement explicit and retryable. Missing config, permission, data, or finality stays explicit and retryable. Empty rows are not zero, and one observation is not automatically final.
criteria.bar: Keep unavailable or unstable settlement explicit and retryable. Missing config, permission, data, or finality stays explicit and retryable. Empty rows are not zero, and one observation is not automatically final.
criteria.method: Run npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/gcp-api-client.test.ts libs/generic/deployment-driver/src/workspace-host-test-harness.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/hosted-lifecycle-store.test.ts. Require missing descriptor, denied permission, no data, malformed result, empty history, one observation, changed observations and open stability window to remain typed retryable/pending outcomes. Inspect retryPatch to preserve deferral and schedule retry. Healthy requires all absence/finality assertions pass.
criteria.driftMarkers: Missing config/permission/rows or one unstable/recent snapshot becomes zero or settled; retry reason/backoff or original deferral is erased.

Read all canary cost signals for the two named runs: report spendSettlement, spendReconciliation, spendObservations and billingExport presence. Compare with WI-10000614's dated pre-acceptance boundary. Existing legitimate later settlement must cite the supported job observations and finality predicate; absence of rows is unknown, never healthy.
